source_proven_findings: Catalog and generated native data agree on all six endpoint IDs, reverse pairs, rooms, sides, positions and door rotation. Corridor-side arrivals retain separate TO_FORK regions, not the central FORKED_CORRIDOR region.
The three corridor-side targets use room 7 and a 60-unit positive-Z door offset. Age does not alter this formula; policy permits both ages and does not force a different age.
EnBa death sets its authored permanent switch. EnBx initialization independently checks its own high-byte switch and removes the barrier only when that flag is set.
EnBx applies knockback based on its placement yaw or yaw toward Link, including during existing invincibility. TakeDamage checks survivability only and does not establish a path beyond the barrier.

All three final native/AP corridor-return predicates require the existing corresponding tentacle-removal event. The generic TakeDamage alternatives are removed; forward door-approach predicates retain the same events.

conservative_decision.basis: The exact uploaded placement set reproduces route 606 -> 8459 and an initial Open Chest behind a route depending on the generic damage escape; the user reports the adult barrier is impassable. Native source cannot certify that escape without placement/collision data.
conservative_decision.changed_logic: Require the authored WEST/EAST tentacle-clear event before crediting a direct TO_FORK arrival as access to central corridor.
conservative_decision.claim: This removes an unproven escape from default logic. It does not prove that every possible damage boost is physically impossible.

unverified_geometry: The source asset YAML supplies ROM offsets, not the placed EnBx actor list or collision polygons. Exact barrier positions, orientation, high-byte switch params and adult collider overlap with the 60-unit arrival anchor are not independently available.

The branch-to-control event mapping is existing authored native-room logic (NW and NE use WEST; N uses EAST). The killable tentacle within a room is not sufficient to infer which different room controls a corridor barrier.
No anchor relocation, guessed raw actor parameter, blanket adult restriction, switch grant, or temporary flag copy was introduced.
